findings.summary: notifUnreadCountProvider fetches /notifications/unread-count independently. After a tap-to-read mutation, the badge and list count can diverge until both providers revalidate. Derive the count from notificationsProvider locally instead.
_NotificationTile.onTap swallows all exceptions silently. A network failure leaves the tile visually unread with no user feedback. Add a SnackBar on failure to match the pattern in _markAllRead.
The unread-count constant is named unreadCount rather than notificationsUnreadCount, breaking the notifications-prefixed naming pattern. Rename for consistency.
